definitions.explanation: A sleeveless shirt with shoulder straps, worn as a casual summer top or as inner/sports wear. Used by men and women alike.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}はタンクトップが{涼|すず}しい。
examples.english: Tank tops are cool in summer.

examples.japanese: ジムでタンクトップに{着替|きが}えた。
examples.english: I changed into a tank top at the gym.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}いタンクトップの{上|うえ}にシャツを{羽織|はお}った。
examples.english: I threw a shirt on over my white tank top.

notes:
Loanword from English. The name comes from old-style swimming pools called "tanks" where similar tops were worn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タンクトップ{一枚|いちまい}: just a tank top (nothing over it)
- タンクトップを{着|き}る: to wear a tank top
- {綿|めん}のタンクトップ: cotton tank top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ノースリーブ: sleeveless top — broader; covers any sleeveless garment
- キャミソール: camisole — thinner straps, often worn as innerwear
